model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (3.6B active), MXFP4 as released. The model approved today; the baseline every other profile is read against.

answers.sql:
SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND ch.IS_CURR
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE br.IS_CURR = true
    AND d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'::date
    AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'::date
)
SELECT BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN target_date td ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)=2025
)
SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS max_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE MTH_NBR = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_default_clients
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN august_max a ON d.BUS_DT_K = a.max_dt
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       ROUND(AVG(AVRG_RT), 6) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CTY_NM, f.ATM_TXN_F_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT <= '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT CTY_NM, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM t
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAL_DT) = 12
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE CCY_CD1 = 'USD';

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month, COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
    AND dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       escalated_count
FROM c
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_alerts DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT f.TXN_ID) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d
  ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN target_date t
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K, d.DSPLY_NM;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM transfers t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT BUS_ID, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM f
GROUP BY BUS_ID
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.IS_WKND
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM t;

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
), bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT, CCY_CD1, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM dates)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM (
  SELECT a1.ACCT_K
  FROM bal a1
  JOIN bal a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K AND a1.CCY_CD1 = a2.CCY_CD1
  WHERE a1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM dates WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
    AND a2.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM dates WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
    AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
) sub;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND f.RSLTN_AT >= '2025-01-01'::date
    AND f.RSLTN_AT < '2026-01-01'::date
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(AVG(days),2) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT * FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
), prev AS (
  SELECT c1.BUS_ID, c1.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_seg, c2.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_seg
  FROM curr c1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c2
    ON c1.BUS_ID = c2.BUS_ID
   AND c2.VRSN_NBR = c1.VRSN_NBR - 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers_changed
FROM prev
WHERE curr_seg IS DISTINCT FROM prev_seg;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_cust.IS_CURR = true
    AND d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), quarters AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAL_DT) AS qtr
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY BUS_ID, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAL_DT)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT BUS_ID
  FROM quarters
  GROUP BY BUS_ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT qtr) = 4
) q;

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
),
  wire_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wire_2025 w WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND dt.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
    AND dt.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d2025);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amt
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, SUM(f_txn.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON f_txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
  WHERE chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT (cnt_2025::numeric / NULLIF(cnt_2024,0) - 1)*100 AS pct_growth
FROM (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2025
  FROM txn
) t;

WITH month_ends AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K AS month_end_key, d.CAL_DT AS month_end_date
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.IS_MTH_END AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), balances AS (
  SELECT me.month_end_date,
         SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM month_ends me
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = me.month_end_key
  GROUP BY me.month_end_date
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_end_date)::int AS month,
       total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_end_date;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), txns2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
  FROM cust2025 c
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.PSTNG_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers_with_txn FROM txns2025;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
    AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30')
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM cust
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
         d.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = true
    AND dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'::date
    AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'::date
  GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total
FROM (
  SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn
  FROM t
) s
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transfers),0),2) AS pct
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_num,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT month_num,
       cnt,
       SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS running_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_num;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT, d.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
       ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT * fx.MID_RT END
) AS total_eur
FROM t
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON fx.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
  AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.BUS_DT_K, a.RJCTN_RSN_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM f
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT a.TXN_ID, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON a.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(DISTINCT TXN_ID) AS txn_count
FROM txns
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE

WITH last_day AS (

WITH txn AS (

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count

WITH auth AS (

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined

WITH d AS (

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount

WITH t AS (

WITH wire AS (

WITH t AS (

SELECT DISTINCT dsply_nm AS branch_name

WITH txn AS (

  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f

)
SELECT

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT, CCY_CD1, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

    AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
) sub;

WITH complaint_days AS (
  SELECT
    d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cm.RSLTN_AT - cm.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days_to_resolve
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d

  WHERE cm.IS_RSLVD = true

SELECT
  category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(days_to_resolve), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolve

GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY avg_days_to_resolve;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_segment
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS changed_segments
FROM ranked
WHERE prev_segment IS NOT NULL AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev_segment;

WITH txns AS (

  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) t;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON d.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND dt.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
    AND dt.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d2025);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1,
         ORGNL_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       CASE
         WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
           (SELECT ORGNL_AMT FROM transfers t2 WHERE t2.CCY_CD1 = t1.CCY_CD1 AND t2.rn = (cnt+1)/2)
         ELSE
           (SELECT AVG(ORGNL_AMT) FROM transfers t2 WHERE t2.CCY_CD1 = t1.CCY_CD1 AND t2.rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1))
       END AS median_amount
FROM transfers t1
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, SUM(f_acct_txn.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_acct_txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_acct_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f_acct_txn.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
  WHERE d_chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT ROUND((cnt_2025::numeric - cnt_2024)/cnt_2024*100, 1) AS pct_growth
FROM (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2025
  FROM txn
) t;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.IS_MTH_END AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), balances AS (
  SELECT ld.CAL_DT AS month_end,
         SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM last_day ld
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
  GROUP BY ld.CAL_DT
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_end)::int AS month,
       total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_end;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), tx2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN cust2025 c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers_with_txn FROM tx2025;

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE DATE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM valid
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
         c.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR
    AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM (
  SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM transfers
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY CCY_CD1
), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM t)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt / total.total, 2) AS pct
FROM t, total
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS month_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR,
       month_count,
       SUM(month_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT, d.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
       ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT * fx.MID_RT END
) AS total_eur
FROM t
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON fx.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
  AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR';

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR,
       ROUND(100.0 * declined / total, 2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT, f.STLM_AMT, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM f
GROUP BY STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM txn ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.AML_ALRT_F_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.DSPLY_NM, dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR
)
SELECT BR_K, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BR_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-08-31'
    AND d.IS_MTH_END
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN last_day ld ON d.DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE fd.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.CAL_DT, d.CAL_YR_NBR, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM c
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_last AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE IS_MTH_END AND MTH_NBR=8 AND CAL_YR_NBR=2023
  ORDER BY DT_K DESC LIMIT 1
), latest AS (
  SELECT fd.* FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN august_last al ON fd.BUS_DT_K = al.DT_K
  WHERE fd.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM latest fd;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_mid_rate DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT m.MKT_NM,
       SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
GROUP BY m.MKT_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT a.BR_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2025-04-01'
)
SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K AND b.IS_CURR
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM target;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAL_DT) AS mon
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.yr = 2025
  AND d.mon = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM current_customers cc
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 tx ON cc.CUST_K = tx.CUST_K
WHERE tx.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
    AND dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'
    AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM, cnt
FROM cte
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT t.FEE_AMT, d.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON t.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM txn
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01';

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_alerts DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM wr;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND b.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1
), ranked AS (
  SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn r
)
SELECT r.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, r.txn_cnt
FROM ranked r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON r.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE r.rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.ORGNL_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1,
  SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM d)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT AS txn_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.txn_date = d.CAL_DT;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT, CCY_CD1, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM (
  SELECT a1.ACCT_K
  FROM bal a1
  JOIN bal a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K AND a1.CCY_CD1 = a2.CCY_CD1
  WHERE a1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
    AND a2.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
    AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
) sub;

WITH complaint_days AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cm.RSLTN_AT - cm.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days_to_resolve
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
    ON cm.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE cm.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND cm.RSLTN_AT >= '2025-01-01'::timestamptz
    AND cm.RSLTN_AT < '2026-01-01'::timestamptz
)
SELECT category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(days_to_resolve)::numeric,2) AS avg_days_to_resolve
FROM complaint_days
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY avg_days_to_resolve;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR
), prev AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE NOT IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT curr.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr
JOIN prev USING (BUS_ID)
WHERE curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
), custs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM txns t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
), quarters AS (
  SELECT cust_k, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', cal_dt) AS qtr
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY cust_k, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', cal_dt)
), cust_quarters AS (
  SELECT cust_k, COUNT(DISTINCT qtr) AS qtr_cnt
  FROM quarters
  GROUP BY cust_k
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM cust_quarters
WHERE qtr_cnt = 4;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.IS_CURR
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transfers t WHERE t.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 30
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d2025);

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
), t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN dates d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            MAX(ORGNL_AMT) FILTER (WHERE rn = (cnt+1)/2)
          ELSE
            (MAX(ORGNL_AMT) FILTER (WHERE rn = cnt/2) + MAX(ORGNL_AMT) FILTER (WHERE rn = cnt/2 +1))/2
       END AS median_amt
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END)-SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END))::numeric / SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) * 100, 1) AS pct_growth
FROM txn;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.IS_MTH_END AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ld.CAL_DT)::int AS month,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_day ld
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
GROUP BY ld.CAL_DT
ORDER BY ld.CAL_DT;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN cust2025 c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_txn_2025 FROM txns;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE DATE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM cust
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
         d.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = true
    AND dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM (
  SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM t
) s
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d.CAL_DT) AS month_start,
         COUNT(*) AS month_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT month_start,
       month_count,
       SUM(month_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), fx AS (
  SELECT r.BUS_DT_K, r.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
  WHERE r.BS_CCY_CD1='EUR' AND r.QUOT_CCY_CD1='USD'
)
SELECT SUM(
  CASE
    WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1='EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
    ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT * fx.MID_RT
  END
) AS total_eur
FROM t
LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = t.CAL_DT);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT, a.RJCTN_RSN_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAL_DT) AS month,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
